classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class for the API sale cart operations, extending the base Controller class, providing methods for fetching cart details, adding, editing, and removing items from the cart via API endpoints.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles retrieving the current cart status, including products, totals, vouchers, shipping requirements, and outputs the cart data as JSON.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a product to the cart based on POST request parameters such as product_id, quantity, options, and subscription plan, then returns success or error as JSON.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles updating the quantity of an existing cart item identified by key, using POST data, then returns success or error as JSON.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles removing an item from the cart based on provided key, then returns success or error as JSON.
